verified_thesis_baseline.message: docs(thesis): update project methodology and decision records
verified_thesis_baseline.basis: Latest commit touching docs/thesis as verified with git log -- docs/thesis before thesis documentation edits.

checker_files_updated.why: Allowed the reserved synthetic example.invalid domain as non-reference test data rather than a thesis source.
Raised the reference guard wrapper timeout from 30 to 90 seconds after the current repo scan exceeded the stale 30-second budget.

non_thesis_files_intentionally_not_updat.why: This was a documentation/evidence update only; runtime behavior must remain unchanged.
Campaign behavior and response text were out of scope for this phase.
Model weights, adapters, checkpoints, and generated audio were out of scope and not touched.

major_decisions_added: OpenAI public fixture remains source-grounded and self-serve while post-baseline work improves live sales behavior.
Sales-ready means active selling, objection handling, decision movement, fit-based recommendation or disqualification, and loop resistance, not only product explanation.

Dialogue methodology shifted from exact scenario patching toward semantic frame mapping, buyer-state tracking, relation fidelity, ASR alias handling, memory progression, and generalized intent/action planning.
ElevenLabs voice mismatch was treated as configuration/environment precedence, not a hardcoded campaign voice bug.
Future LLM role is conversation move planner only; deterministic layers own memory, verifier, source/fact boundary, safety, side-effect boundary, and anti-loop checks.
Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen LoRA adapters, Ollama Qwen 7B, and tested small local models are not live-ready for per-turn voice use.
Action-id-only selection, distilled small selectors, and non-LLM classifier/action selectors remain future research paths.
Liquid Audio is retired as TTS/voice backend after failed manual listening review and retained as architecture inspiration only.
Fish Audio S2 is inspiration for an internal backend-neutral prosody taxonomy; Fish is not installed/run and raw tags must not leak into buyer-facing speech.
ElevenLabs remains the current live voice path; Kokoro remains optional/future benchmark only.
Evidence validators and quality gates are separate; validator pass is not sales/live/product readiness.
references_added_or_updated: Fish Audio S2, fish-speech, s2-pro, speech.fish.audio references
Local LLM/Ollama benchmark evidence registry and model identifiers
methodology_updates: Phase-based implementation from committed evidence packets
Manual live/listening review as qualitative ground truth
Evidence validators versus quality gates split
Local model and audio experiments gated and isolated
No live runtime wiring without explicit quality and latency gates
evaluation_rubric_updates: Live-demo readiness versus thesis-demo readiness versus product readiness
